title: CP-2 DeviceEvent v1alpha1
description: Body of POST /api/v1/devices/{deviceId}/events: a device-level record of the engine's status outbox (core/reconciler.py refuse()). It shares the per-device seq with the deployment status records (the cloud drops seq <= last seen per device). Today one event: DesiredStateRefused, sent once per distinct (document, reason) (lead decision 2026-10-17).

documentDigest.description: sha256 of the refused response body.

offeredManifestVersion.description: manifestVersion of the refused document when it could be read.
